instruction: Enable the helloExtension directory from the Desktop in Chrome's extension settings.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get install unzip -y && unzip /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip -d /home/user/Desktop/ && rm /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip

metadata.explanation: Variation 5: Uses 'enable' verb and mentions 'extension settings'. Evaluator verifies the extension path /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension is loaded in Chrome. Agent needs to navigate to chrome://extensions/, turn on Developer mode, and use Load unpacked to add the extension.

No UI/state dependency: Chrome Preferences file is persistent and accessible without requiring UI to be open, no postconfig needed despite heuristic warning
